note: Three disjoint seed sets. LiberoEnv maps a seed to a LIBERO init state via seed % 50, so the sets are disjoint at BOTH the seed level and the init-state level: optimization uses init states 0-29, the promotion gate 30-39, benchmark evaluation 40-49. Eval init states are never seen by the optimizer or the gate. Hand-rolled pose jitter is applied only to opt/gate rollouts, never to eval.
